name: Novotel Living Singapore Orchard
short_description: An 85-unit serviced-apartment property on Claymore Hill off Orchard Road, a 5-minute walk to Orchard MRT, built for extended-stay guests with full kitchens and laundry.
ai_summary: Novotel Living Singapore Orchard is a serviced-apartment property at 8 Claymore Hill, tucked just off Orchard Road and about a five-minute walk from Orchard MRT station. Its 85 studios and one-to-three-bedroom apartments are aimed squarely at extended-stay guests, each with a fully equipped kitchen, in-room laundry, and a separate living area, backed by a pool, fitness centre, and daily housekeeping. Guest reviews are strongly positive, repeatedly citing the spacious-for-Singapore layouts, friendly and attentive staff, and the convenience of stepping out directly onto Orchard Road, with only occasional gripes about lift waits during a 2026 refurbishment and inconsistent cleaning between visits. It functions less like a conventional hotel and more like a serviced residence, which makes it best suited to relocating professionals, families, and business travellers staying a week or longer rather than a short weekend visit.

elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 85 studios and 1-3 bedroom apartments, all with fully equipped kitchens and in-room laundry
Steps from Orchard Road shopping and a roughly 5-minute walk to Orchard MRT
Consistently praised staff friendliness and attentiveness across guest reviews
Genuinely spacious layouts by Singapore standards, well suited to families and long stays
Pool, fitness centre, and daily housekeeping despite the apartment-style format
cons: A minimum stay of several consecutive nights applies, so it isn't set up for one-night bookings
One lift was undergoing upgrade works into October 2026, and some guests have flagged inconsistent cleaning between stays
research_highlights: TripAdvisor guest reviews rank the property near the top of Singapore's specialty-lodging category, with kitchen equipment, staff service, and the Orchard Road location the most repeated praise
Reviewers describe it as functioning more like a home than a hotel, citing supplied welcome groceries and drinks alongside standard housekeeping
The official site confirms 85 total units split across studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartment configurations up to roughly 175 sqm
research_watchouts: As of mid-2026 one lift in the building was under upgrade works (scheduled June 29 to October 7, 2026), which some recent guests flagged as a wait-time inconvenience
No independent blogger or publication review (as opposed to OTA guest reviews) could be confirmed for this property, so external_coverage.reviews is left empty rather than guessed

faqs.question: Is Novotel Living Singapore Orchard a hotel or serviced apartments?
faqs.answer: It operates as serviced apartments rather than a conventional hotel -- all 85 units are studios or one-, two-, or three-bedroom apartments with full kitchens, in-room laundry, and separate living areas, built for extended stays of a week or more rather than short overnight visits.

faqs.question: How far is Novotel Living Singapore Orchard from Orchard MRT?
faqs.answer: It's about a five-minute walk, roughly 750 metres, from Orchard MRT station. The property sits on Claymore Hill just off Orchard Road itself, putting shopping malls, restaurants, cafes, and the Singapore Botanic Gardens all within easy, mostly sheltered walking distance of the apartments for guests without a car.
